stories.headline: Hong Kong mega bridge’s popularity takes toll on helicopter, ferry services: lawmaker

opening: The number of vehicles using a mega bridge linking Hong Kong with Zhuhai and Macau hit a record high last year, the South China Morning Post has learned, with a lawmaker saying the boom has taken a heavy toll on ferry services and a long-running helicopter service.

Transport Department figures obtained by the SCMP showed that vehicle flow via the popular Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macau Bridge reached a record high of 5.21 million last year, up more than 19 per cent from 4.36 million in 2024.

stories.title: Chinese national rescued from Nepal tunnel 10 days after flash flood
stories.summary: A Chinese national was pulled alive from a tunnel in Nepal on Saturday, authorities said, 10 days after a wall of ice, rock and mud tore through a Himalayan valley, killing more than 1,300 people and leaving over 5,600 missing. The Nepali army said the person, named only as Luhaitao, was rescued from inside a 225-metre (246-yard) tunnel at the Upper Trishuli-1 Hydropower Project. On Friday, rescue workers pulled two people from another tunnel at the Upper Trishuli 3A Hydropower Station on the same river. Rescue workers have said they believe the August 26 collapse of a glacier on the upper reaches of the river trapped at least 900 people in tunnels related to six hydropower projects. Footage shared by the Nepali army showed Luhaitao being given emergency medical attention inside a helicopter, which took him to an army hospital.

stories.title: Shashi Tharoor on why India must rethink its West Asia security strategy
stories.summary: In his latest column in The Hindu, Shashi Tharoor examines India’s approach to security in West Asia and asks whether New Delhi can continue its policy of strategic distance as the region’s security architecture changes. He argues that West Asia is crucial to India’s energy security, trade, remittances and economic interests, and says India should consider a more active role in the region. Tharoor also discusses emerging security partnerships, India’s defence capabilities and the need to protect its long-term strategic interests without entering rigid military alliances.
